quote: We selected 10 Benchmarks B from Hugging-Face Open LLM Leaderboards ... including TruthfulQA, ARC, Winogrande, GSM8k, Hellaswag, GPQA, MUSR, BBH, MATH, MMLU-Pro.

With over 1 million open-source models available on HuggingFace (including more than 170,000 text generation models) and prominent leaderboards such as the Open LLM Leaderboard and AlpacaEval tracking over 100,000 models, there is a pressing need for scalable evaluation methodologies.
outputs: Model-generated answers or predictions on benchmark questions
The paper evaluates LLMs on text generation tasks across multiple benchmarks, focusing on model ranking via generated responses to benchmark questions.

quote: The Spearman Coefficient (ρ) is used for assessing the rank correlation and Pearson Coefficient r is used for assessing Score Distribution Preservation.
The Spearman Coefficient (Sedgwick, 2014) ρ is used for assessing the rank correlation and Pearson Coefficient r is used for assessing Score Distribution Preservation.
